pack.name: Microsoft cloud security benchmark v2 architecture baseline
pack.description: Architecture checks mapped to selected Microsoft cloud security benchmark v2 preview controls. Microsoft tooling links are guidance, not compliance certification.

rules.title: Network segmentation boundaries
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify segmented network zones and the controls that restrict traffic between them.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use a Defender for Cloud recommendation and Azure Policy built-in as signals, then document intended trust boundaries.

rules.title: Private connectivity for sensitive services
rules.description: Architecture evidence should show private connectivity for sensitive platform services and the associated name-resolution path.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Azure Policy built-ins to identify public exposure and Defender for Cloud recommendations to prioritize exceptions.

rules.title: Internet-facing service protection
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify internet entry points, filtering controls, and an owner for exposed services.
rules.remediationGuidance: Review Defender for Cloud attack-path and recommendation signals alongside Azure Policy exposure controls.

rules.title: Application network protection
rules.description: Architecture evidence should show application-layer network protections for ingress, egress, and service-to-service traffic.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations for posture signals and record compensating controls for traffic that cannot be filtered centrally.

rules.title: Secure DNS architecture
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify authoritative, private, and monitored DNS paths for each workload boundary.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Azure Policy built-ins where available and document DNS monitoring in the architecture manifest.

rules.title: Identity system of record
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify the authoritative identity provider and its trust boundaries for workforce and workload identities.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Entra ID as the identity signal and record any external federation or synchronization boundary.

rules.title: Strong authentication
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify where strong authentication and conditional access protect user and administrative access.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Entra ID sign-in and conditional-access reporting to validate the intended authentication boundary.

rules.title: Application identity hygiene
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify managed identities, service principals, and credential ownership for applications.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Entra ID application and workload identity reporting; prefer managed identities where the hosting service supports them.

rules.title: Conditional access policy coverage
rules.description: Architecture evidence should show the conditions that gate risky sign-ins, unmanaged devices, and sensitive operations.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Entra ID conditional access insights and document excluded identities, break-glass handling, and review ownership.

rules.title: Identity anomaly monitoring
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify how anomalous identity activity is detected, triaged, and retained for investigation.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Entra ID identity protection signals and route actionable events to Microsoft Sentinel.

rules.title: Privileged access model
rules.description: Architecture evidence should define administrative roles, approval boundaries, and the separation of privileged duties.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Entra ID and privileged identity management reporting to identify standing privilege and approval paths.

rules.title: Just-in-time privilege
rules.description: Architecture evidence should show that sensitive administrative roles are eligible and activated for a bounded period.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Entra ID privileged identity management signals and document activation approval and duration.

rules.title: Privileged workstation boundary
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify the trusted device or workstation boundary used for high-impact administration.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Entra ID device and conditional-access signals to enforce the administrative workstation boundary.

rules.title: Emergency access controls
rules.description: Architecture evidence should document break-glass identities, monitored use, and recovery ownership without weakening normal controls.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Entra ID sign-in reporting and route emergency-use alerts to Microsoft Sentinel.

rules.title: Privileged activity audit
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify the logs and review process for privileged role activation and administrative changes.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Entra ID audit signals and Microsoft Sentinel analytics for privileged activity review.

rules.title: Sensitive data inventory
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify sensitive data classes, locations, owners, and the flows that cross trust boundaries.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations where available and document classification ownership in the manifest.

rules.title: Data classification and labeling
rules.description: Architecture evidence should connect data classification to access, retention, encryption, and monitoring decisions.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud data-protection recommendations where available and record label ownership and exceptions.

rules.title: Encryption at rest
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify encryption at rest, key ownership, rotation, and recovery for sensitive stores.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Azure Policy built-ins and Defender for Cloud recommendations to find missing encryption configuration.

rules.title: Encryption in transit
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify protected paths, protocol minimums, and certificate or key ownership for data in transit.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Azure Policy built-ins for protocol posture and document private connectivity or compensating controls.

rules.title: Key and certificate lifecycle
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify key and certificate stores, rotation, expiry monitoring, and recovery responsibilities.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Azure Policy built-ins for Key Vault posture and route expiry or access anomalies to Microsoft Sentinel.

rules.title: Asset inventory ownership
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify the authoritative inventory, ownership fields, and reconciliation process for cloud assets.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud inventory and recommendations as the operational signal, with documented ownership exceptions.

rules.title: Asset metadata and tagging
rules.description: Architecture evidence should define required tags and metadata for owner, environment, data class, and lifecycle.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Azure Policy built-ins to audit or enforce required tags and document approved exemptions.

rules.title: Approved service governance
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify how new services and resource types are approved before production use.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Azure Policy built-ins for allowed resource types and document the approval authority in policy constraints.

rules.title: Security inventory access
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify who can read and change asset inventory and how that access is reviewed.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Entra ID role assignments and Defender for Cloud access recommendations to review inventory permissions.

rules.title: Resource lifecycle governance
rules.description: Architecture evidence should show how resources are approved, changed, retired, and removed from security monitoring.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Azure Policy built-ins for governance controls and retain change signals in Microsoft Sentinel where investigation is needed.

rules.title: Security log collection
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify security-relevant sources, collection paths, and owners for cloud audit logs.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Microsoft Sentinel connectors and Azure Policy built-ins to identify missing diagnostic coverage.

rules.title: Central security analysis
rules.description: Architecture evidence should show where security logs are centralized, correlated, retained, and protected from unauthorized change.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Microsoft Sentinel as the analysis surface and document workspace boundaries, retention, and access.

rules.title: Threat detection coverage
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify native and custom detections for identity, network, workload, and data threats.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Microsoft Sentinel analytics and Defender for Cloud recommendations to document detection ownership and gaps.

rules.title: Alert triage and response routing
rules.description: Architecture evidence should define alert severity, routing, suppression, and escalation paths for security operations.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Microsoft Sentinel incidents and automation rules as the operational signal; record human ownership and SLA.

rules.title: Log retention and integrity
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify retention periods, immutable or protected destinations, and time synchronization for investigations.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Microsoft Sentinel and Azure Policy built-ins to validate retention and diagnostic configuration.

rules.title: Incident response preparation
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify incident roles, contacts, telemetry dependencies, and approved response tooling.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Microsoft Sentinel incident workflows and document response ownership and escalation boundaries.

rules.title: Incident detection and analysis
rules.description: Architecture evidence should show how signals are correlated into incidents and how analysts preserve investigation context.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Microsoft Sentinel incidents and Defender for Cloud recommendations as the correlated evidence surfaces.

rules.title: Containment and eradication paths
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify isolation, credential revocation, quarantine, and recovery actions for major incident classes.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Microsoft Sentinel automation and Defender for Cloud recommendations to connect detections to approved response actions.

rules.title: Incident communications
rules.description: Architecture evidence should define protected communication channels, decision authorities, and evidence-sharing boundaries during incidents.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Microsoft Sentinel incident ownership and document out-of-band communication and notification requirements.

rules.title: Post-incident learning
rules.description: Architecture evidence should show how incident outcomes, control gaps, and corrective actions feed back into the security baseline.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Microsoft Sentinel incident records and Defender for Cloud recommendation trends to track corrective action.

rules.title: Security posture baseline
rules.description: Architecture evidence should define the target cloud security posture, review cadence, and accountable risk owner.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations and secure score as signals, without treating the score as certification.

rules.title: Configuration drift monitoring
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify how security configuration drift is detected, assigned, and corrected.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations and Azure Policy compliance for drift signals and remediation ownership.

rules.title: Vulnerability assessment coverage
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify vulnerability assessment scope, scan ownership, exceptions, and remediation SLAs.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud vulnerability recommendations and document assets or images outside scan coverage.

rules.title: Security testing and remediation
rules.description: Architecture evidence should connect security testing results to findings, owners, due dates, and verified closure.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations as an input, while recording testing scope and residual risk separately.

rules.title: Secure configuration reporting
rules.description: Architecture evidence should define posture reporting, exception handling, and escalation for resources outside the target baseline.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations and Azure Policy compliance reports to support periodic posture review.

rules.title: Endpoint protection coverage
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify endpoint classes, protection ownership, and gaps for compute workloads.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations to confirm protection plan and agent or agentless coverage.

rules.title: Endpoint detection and response
rules.description: Architecture evidence should show how endpoint detections are collected, correlated, and routed for investigation.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations and Microsoft Sentinel for central incident correlation.

rules.title: Malware protection posture
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify malware prevention, scanning cadence, exclusions, and exception ownership.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations to surface missing protection and document justified exclusions.

rules.title: Endpoint isolation path
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify how compromised endpoints are isolated without losing required forensic evidence.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations and Microsoft Sentinel automation to connect detection to isolation procedures.

rules.title: Endpoint exception governance
rules.description: Architecture evidence should define expiry, approval, and monitoring for endpoint protection exclusions.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendation status and document every exception owner and expiry.

rules.title: Backup coverage
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify protected data and configuration assets, backup ownership, and backup frequency.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations and Azure Policy built-ins to identify missing backup coverage.

rules.title: Backup isolation and protection
rules.description: Architecture evidence should show how backups are isolated from production compromise and protected from unauthorized deletion.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Azure Policy built-ins and Defender for Cloud recommendations for backup posture and protection signals.

rules.title: Recovery testing
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify recovery objectives, test cadence, dependencies, and evidence of successful restoration.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations where available and record restoration evidence outside the posture score.

rules.title: Recovery dependency documentation
rules.description: Architecture evidence should connect recovery plans to identity, networking, keys, data, and operational dependencies.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations as a gap signal and document dependencies in the architecture manifest.

rules.title: Backup retention governance
rules.description: Architecture evidence should define retention, legal hold, deletion protection, and cost ownership for backups.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Azure Policy built-ins where available and document retention exceptions and review dates.

rules.title: Secure development lifecycle
rules.description: Architecture evidence should connect security requirements, design review, testing, and deployment approval.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations for DevOps posture signals and record organization-specific gates in policy constraints.

rules.title: Source and pipeline access
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify repository, pipeline, service connection, and deployment identity boundaries.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Entra ID for workload identity and Defender for Cloud DevOps recommendations where available.

rules.title: Pre-deployment security checks
rules.description: Architecture evidence should show which code, dependency, secret, and infrastructure checks must pass before deployment.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud DevOps recommendations as an input and document required pipeline evidence.

rules.title: Deployment integrity
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify artifact provenance, signing or validation, promotion boundaries, and rollback ownership.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Defender for Cloud recommendations for DevOps posture and document artifact integrity controls in the manifest.

rules.title: DevOps security monitoring
rules.description: Architecture evidence should identify security telemetry from source, build, release, and deployment operations.
rules.remediationGuidance: Use Microsoft Sentinel for centralized DevOps security events and Defender for Cloud recommendations for posture gaps.
